authorName.name: Author name
authorName.description: Used for comments and tracked changes.

editorTheme.name: Theme
editorTheme.description: Use the system theme by default, or pin this editor to light or dark mode.

showRuler.name: Ruler
showRuler.description: Show the page ruler above the document body by default.

defaultZoom.name: Default zoom
defaultZoom.description: Initial zoom for DOCX files when they open.

autosave.name: Autosave
autosave.description: Automatically save the document shortly after changes.

createBackupsBeforeSave.name: Backups
createBackupsBeforeSave.description: Create one timestamped backup before the first overwrite in each open DOCX session.

enableDocxSearchIndex.name: DOCX search index
enableDocxSearchIndex.description: Off by default. When enabled, extracts text from DOCX files into a local cache for vault-wide DOCX search.

autoIndexDocxSearch.name: Auto-index DOCX changes
autoIndexDocxSearch.description: Off by default. When enabled with the DOCX search index, keeps the cache updated as DOCX files change.

rebuildDocxSearchIndex.name: Rebuild DOCX search index
rebuildDocxSearchIndex.description: Refresh the searchable cache for DOCX files in this vault.

disableDocxFiles.name: Turn off for DOCX files
disableDocxFiles.description: Turns off plugin specifically for DOCX files in favor of another plugin </3

debugLogging.name: Debug logging
debugLogging.description: Log DOCX and PowerPoint diagnostics to the developer console and the in-memory Native PowerPoint Doc Editor log.

copyDocxLog.name: Copy DOCX log
copyDocxLog.description: Copy DOCX-specific Native PowerPoint Doc Editor logs to the clipboard.

autosave.name: Autosave edits
autosave.description: Save editable PowerPoint files 1500 ms after edits settle. When disabled, closing or switching files writes unsaved edits to a recovery copy without overwriting the original.

showInspector.name: Show inspector panel
showInspector.description: Show the object inspector panel on the right side of the PowerPoint editor. Off by default.

hideUnsupportedSvg.name: Hide unsupported SVG details
hideUnsupportedSvg.description: Temporarily hide unsupported PowerPoint SVG details in the Obsidian preview. Off by default. This does not delete them from the PPTX file.

yoloMode.name: Open PowerPoints with YOLO mode
yoloMode.description: Remember YOLO mode for future PPTX files so the original slide SVG is shown without preview cleanup.

disablePptx.name: Turn off for PPTX files
disablePptx.description: Turns off plugin specifically for PPTX files in favor of another plugin </3

fileHandoff.reloadDocxNotice: Reload Obsidian or disable/re-enable this plugin to update DOCX file handling.
fileHandoff.reloadPptxNotice: Reload Obsidian or disable/re-enable this plugin to update PPTX file handling.

templates.title: Free presentation templates
templates.description: A few places to find starter decks you can download or customize.

copyFullLog.name: Copy full debug log
copyFullLog.description: Copy all Native PowerPoint Doc Editor logs produced for DOCX and PowerPoint to the clipboard.
